scope: Whole upstream repository synchronization; rule dataset and metadata update only; retain personalized AllInOne runtime and all personal files.
manual_review_decisions: Read actual old/new rule payload differences and metadata from all 452 archived versions, each matched to its pinned Git blob. Complete untruncated trees show 226 rule/ files changed with no additions, deletions or mode changes. Full tree and body evidence is authoritative rather than abbreviated commit metadata.

Advertising_All and its no-resolve variant change 291034 to 291723 active rows: 689 domain-suffix additions, no removals. AdvertisingTest changes 315669 to 318641: 3168 domain additions and 196 removals, retaining exact-host versus suffix behavior. AdGuard source representations are retained verbatim, including their distinct counts for exact/suffix normalization.

ChinaIPs changes 19609 to 19611 rows, splitting 211.99.8.0/21 into 211.99.8.0/22, 211.99.12.0/24 and 211.99.14.0/23, excluding 211.99.13.0/24. ChinaIPsTest changes 22989 to 22990, also replacing broad 110.40/15 and fragmented 110.42 ranges with 110.42.16.0/20 and adding four 2406:840 IPv6 networks. Preserve no-resolve flags and distinct no-IPv6 variants.

Lan adds exact DOMAIN localhost.weixin.qq.com and localhost.work.weixin.qq.com rather than a weixin.qq.com suffix.

Apple, Blizzard, Game and ChinaMax variants only change ignored metadata; their active rules are identical. AdGuard AdvertisingLite and Privacy active rules are unchanged, and Surge AdvertisingLite files are byte-identical to the prior source.

All 32 README changes are timestamps and numeric counts only. All 47 changed YAML payloads parse with CSafeLoader. Three DOMAIN-SET changed-domain sets match their full Surge rules, preserving leading-dot suffix matching and plain exact-host matching. Validate all 12223 changed domain/keyword variant rows and 68 CIDR variant rows without changing the source lists.

All non-rule upstream entries, including AllInOne, script directories, author/license files and workflows, are unchanged. Original AllInOne and personalized module match exact reviewed bytes. Both runtime JS dependencies match mutable and pinned URLs and compile without execution.

Preserve the two user-confirmed advertisement/advertising Pinterest and Pinimg authority exclusions verbatim. Existing ICU cases confirm their scope and other-host equivalence; no broadened exclusions, split diagnostic modules or runtime configuration adaptation.

Apply the reviewed rule subtree only after conflict-free three-way proof. Preserve all personal files and review history plus both commit parents. No reset, forced publication, device test, workflow enabling, website restoration or cloud migration.
